start.text: (The headline, folded toward you: 'HIVR - VISITING INSTITUTE STUDY ENTERS THIRD PHASE'.) You young people and your reels. Read. See - a foreign institute, doing a study in Hebbal. Third phase!

what.text: Of what, they don't say! Four columns and they don't say. In my time a study was something you did before exams. (He turns the page to the cricket.)

which.text: HIVR. Hindi? Hebbal? I don't know, they only say the initials, like it's a friend. Visiting, it says. Visiting since two years. (He turns the page to the cricket.)

again.text: (Cricket page now. He has stopped reading it.)
